packageRules.description: This repo ships no package, so the config:recommended default of 'chore(deps)' would prefix every PR here without carrying any signal. Workflow bumps are CI changes, matching the existing 'ci(workflows):' history.

Own reusable workflows are referenced by the floating v0 tag. A tag that never moves is invisible to Renovate - only the digest pin added by helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests turns a v0.x release into a visible update, and the '# v0' comment it keeps alongside preserves the readable major. Grouped so every workflow calling into github-workflows moves in one PR instead of drifting apart.
